head: edb9039f07c08d184f45dd010b54bf41461b5c04
classification_reasons: Blast radius unchanged from phase (c): the new gate check lesson_and_eval is registered in CHECKS_BY_PHASE['e'] and will park every future incident change at gate (e) on up to eight distinct conditions, and /sdlc-deploy and /sdlc-maintain's instruction text change for every project pinned to the new plugin version.

Size and shape: this is still an 18-file real source/test change (new module plugin/lessons/index.py, a new gate check split across checks.py/artifacts.py, two command-file rewrites, a template README rewrite, a documented sdlc.yaml key, a two-manifest version bump) plus three new test files/sections — well beyond 'few files'.

The spec's own history (multiple rounds of flagged concerns on tag vocabulary, Windows newline stability and the runbook field source, closed only in the final round) and the fact that frontmatter parsing, a generated index and a new deterministic gate check are all new code the existing suite never exercised before this change keep this out of 'code the existing tests already cover'.
attempted: Intent: re-checked the phase (d) diff (merge-base...HEAD) against intent.md's proposed outcome; no code changed since phase (c) except the phase (d) evidence artifacts (test.log/build.log/lint.log deferred marks, run-d.json, verifier.md, status.yaml's phase bump). The feature itself still matches intent point for point; no scope drift introduced at this phase.

Spec and plan: independently re-read plugin/lessons/index.py (314 lines), plugin/gate/artifacts.py's LESSON_REQUIRED_FIELDS/LESSON_STATUSES/EVAL_PROMPT/EVAL_CHECKS/lesson_glob, and plugin/gate/checks.py's lesson_and_eval + its registration in CHECKS_BY_PHASE['e'] only (confirmed absent from CHECKS_BY_PHASE['f']). Traced build_index_text's grouping/sorting (stable two-pass sort, file-name tie-break), the (stale) suffix strip in check(), read_entry's render-field validation, and the frontmatter split regex against spec.md's determinism bullet and plan.md's file list: every behavior spec.md/plan.md commits to is present and matches, including the eighth 'two lesson files matching the glob' fail case plan.md's self-found gap added.

Proof: this phase's test.log/build.log/lint.log correctly carry the '# <command> — deferred to the runner — <time>' marker (CI-deferred session, plugin 0.3.2 item 3b) rather than a claim; verifier.md correctly treats this as a phase-(d) deferred-CI verification, reads gate-c.json's already-green, non-deferred commands record (build/test/lint all exit 0, 1429 passed) instead of re-running anything, and exercises the actual diff by reading index.py/checks.py/artifacts.py in full plus tests/test_lessons.py (14 tests) and the new tests/test_gate.py section line by line against plan.md's Proof enumeration. I independently spot-checked several of those tests (zero-lesson tree, class normalisation, newest-first/file-name tie-break, the CRLF-tolerant check(), the frontmatter-split-stops-at-second-marker test, every lesson_and_eval fail case) and confirmed each asserts the real code path (not a mock) and would fail if the corresponding bug were reintroduced (e.g. a wrong glob, a swapped stale-suffix comparison, a missing supersedes-retirement check).

Blast radius: confirmed via the diff --stat that no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, this repo's root sdlc.yaml) is touched; template/sdlc.yaml and docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md are plugin-shipped content per plan.md's own argument, not this repo's guardrails. No risk_list item (auth, money movement, production-config, data migration) applies: the only new data shape is markdown frontmatter plus a generated, never-hand-edited index file, consistent with data-conventions rule 3. hook-log.jsonl for this phase shows no denied or guardrail-adjacent action.

Policies: data-conventions (no personal/sensitive field; every new frontmatter field is a constant, date, tag or internal identifier) and definition-of-done's split between deterministic gate checks and advisory eval-content review (lesson_and_eval checks only shape) hold unchanged from (c); the earlier security-baseline false positive (prose 'eval(' matching the dangerous-call scanner) was fixed in commit bfe078b and I re-confirmed no 'eval(' pattern remains in template/ or plugin/commands/.

Tests: re-read tests/test_lessons.py and the new tests/test_gate.py::test_lesson_and_eval_* section (lines ~2440-2587) and tests/test_commands_and_skills.py's new assertions on sdlc-deploy.md step 0b and sdlc-maintain.md step 1; each isolates exactly one broken precondition per test and asserts the whole rendered 'what I need from you' block where relevant, not a substring. No pre-existing test was weakened and this is a feature change, not a fix-type change, so the test-lock rule does not apply; test_gate_f_waits_for_the_owner_s_triage... is confirmed present and unchanged, proving the new check's phase guard.
